product.name: Ocular Foundry
product.description: A platform for annotating, reviewing, and managing multi-modal data labeling workflows with dataset versioning and collaborative features.

product.name: Ocular Bolt
product.description: A service that accelerates data labeling by incorporating expert human feedback into the annotation process.

product.name: Ocular Foundry RESTful API
product.description: An API providing programmatic access to multi-modal datasets and annotation workflows within Ocular Foundry.

product.name: Ocular AI SDK
product.description: A software development kit for efficient dataset downloads, transfers, and integration with existing AI workflows.

product.name: Ocular Notebooks
product.description: An open-source repository of notebooks for AI, machine learning, and computer vision experiments and development.
